name: gemini-residue
prompt: Can you clean this up? It's going into our company history page.
expectations: The response identifies the [cite: N] markers and the [span_2](start_span)/(end_span) markers as chatbot markup residue
The response names Gemini as the likely source of the markers
All bracketed markers are removed from the output text
The surrounding prose is preserved essentially unchanged: the facts (Leeds, 2011, 38 staff, two presses, 2023 employee trust) are all still present and the sentences are not restyled
